reference.title: Platen Typewriter Intro How to Interaction

beats: Opens at night: the paper is dark and the lamp on the rail throws a warm cone up the page; typed words inside the cone read, words outside it sink into the dark
The lamp follows the pointer along the rail, and its cone decides which typed words you can read
Holding either side of the lamp's capsule switches to day: the cone goes out and the paper brightens (0.4 s); holding again dims to night (0.4 s) and the cone grows back (0.5 s)
